findings.claim: The schema_version rejection guard added to scripts/generate-scorecard-report.py in fix-round-2 (lines 207-218) has no automated regression test in tests/scorecard-report/test_scorecard_report.py. The R2 mitigation for COR-R2-MAJ-001 explicitly requested a standalone test that writes an index with schema_version '999.0' and asserts exit code 1 with no output file written. That test was not added; FIX-ROUND-2.md substitutes a manual empirical smoke-test ('PASS'). The guard code is correct; the gap is coverage-only.
findings.evidence: tests/scorecard-report/test_scorecard_report.py contains three test functions: test_generator_matches_golden (golden-file parametrized over fixtures/empty, single-verified, mixed — all schema_version '0.1'), test_report_excludes_waiver_content (same fixtures), test_missing_index_fails_with_clear_error (missing file path). No function exercises schema_version='999.0' rejection in the generator. FIX-ROUND-2.md §Smoke-test: 'Empirical rejection test: bad schema_version causes generator to exit 1 with unsupported scorecard-index schema_version stderr. PASS.' R2 COR-R2-MAJ-001 mitigation (review-correctness-r2.json): 'Add a second parametrized golden-file test case (or a standalone test) in tests/scorecard-report/ that writes an index with schema_version 999.0 and asserts main() returns exit code 1 with no output file written.' That specific test is absent from the suite.
findings.impact: A future refactor that inadvertently drops or reorders the guard in main() will not be caught by automated CI before merge. The manual smoke-test in FIX-ROUND-2.md is not executed on every push; only the pytest suite is gated. Risk is low given CODEOWNERS gating on this file, but the guard has no regression anchor in the test suite.
findings.mitigation: Add a test function to tests/scorecard-report/test_scorecard_report.py: write an index JSON with schema_version='999.0' to tmp_path, invoke the generator via subprocess with --index pointing to it and --out to a fresh tmp file, assert result.returncode != 0 and 'unsupported scorecard-index schema_version' in result.stderr, and assert the output file was not created. This is a 10-line addition mirroring the existing test_missing_index_fails_with_clear_error pattern.
